title: Planetes
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 2075 the crew of the debris-collecting ship Toy Box clears orbital junk that threatens satellites and stations. Hachimaki dreams of owning a ship and joins the Jupiter mission after a bout of space sickness of the mind, while Tanabe, Yuri and Fee each face loss, terrorism and the costs of reaching into space. Dark Horse reissued the Tokyopop translation in two omnibuses; rating not confirmed (to verify).
life_message: It holds up love and connection with others, not solitary ambition, as what gives life in the cosmos meaning.

winners_losers: Hachimaki reaches Jupiter but learns contentment and love, Tanabe's view of love prevails, and terrorists and militarists lose sympathy. Sympathy goes to connection and care for the planet over solitary ambition.
